sources.fact: GET /ncc/campaigns: baseSearchId, recordSize, selector NEXT/PREVIOUS; array of Campaign with customerId, campaignTp, userLock, ELIGIBLE/PAUSED/DELETED status. Swagger version 2.0 is metadata.

GET /stats accepts ids, fields JSON, KST timeRange JSON and allDays. SummaryStatResponse.data contains SummaryStatMap id/impCnt/clkCnt/salesAmt; validate this documented selected response. Report Swagger version 1.0 is metadata; live wire envelope remains untested.
Dynamic per-customer throttling without fixed QPS. Use own/delegated account keys; advertisers must not hand keys to third parties.

Entity GETs return IDs, customer, parent, pause and submitted controls. Ad.ad is JSON text; SITE channel GET identifies channelTp/customer. Keyword CPC is 70–100000 KRW. Dates require KST midnight. Readback checks explicit locks, budgets, dates, content and parentage.

sources.quote: The type of adgroup system bidding.
sources.fact: Adgroup and AdgroupRequest define systemBiddingType with enum NONE/ML separately from bidAmt. Freeze NONE for fixed-CPC verification and compare it on readback; missing or ML mode remains unknown even when bidAmt matches. Documentation rechecked 2026-10-24; no live API calls.
CAMPAIGN_ENDED applies when today exceeds the end date, supporting an inclusive vendor calendar end. Exact mapping from OM TimeWindow remains unresolved; no writes.
AdRequest.userLock is documented for update, without explicit create support. Treat disabled TEXT_45 creation as UNVERIFIED; do not create enabled then pause.
The ad content example has headline/description and pc/mobile final/display links.
